headword: {小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A business or person that sells goods directly to consumers, as opposed to wholesalers who sell to other businesses.

examples.japanese: {小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}に{商品|しょうひん}を{卸|おろ}す。
{地元|じもと}の{小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}が{大型店|おおがたてん}に{押|お}されている。
examples.english: Local retailers are being squeezed by large stores.

examples.japanese: ネット{通販|つうはん}の{普及|ふきゅう}で{小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}の{経営|けいえい}{環境|かんきょう}は{大|おお}きく{変|か}わった。
examples.english: The spread of online shopping has drastically changed the business environment for retailers.

notes:
Composed of {小売|こうり} (retail) + {業者|ぎょうしゃ} (business operator). Refers to businesses that sell products directly to end consumers. Can refer to both individual shop owners and larger retail companies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}に{卸|おろ}す: to wholesale to retailers
- {小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}の{経営|けいえい}: retail business management
- {大手|おおて}{小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}: major retailers
- {小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}と{消費者|しょうひしゃ}: retailers and consumers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {卸売業者|おろしうりぎょうしゃ}: wholesaler — sells to businesses rather than consumers
- {販売店|はんばいてん}: retail outlet / dealer — refers to the store itself rather than the business entity
- {小売店|こうりてん}: retail shop — focuses on the physical store rather than the business operator
